intro: I work full-time as a Solution Analyst at Deloitte, modernizing legacy systems to optimize client operations. Aside from that, I spend a considerable amount of my spare time challenging myself with new technologies and expanding my skillset. I enjoy solving difficult problems and strive to make an impact on the world around me.

hero.name: Rishi Gadhia
hero.role: Solution Analyst @ Deloitte · Go · Linux · systems

projects.title: Personal Projects
projects.gameReviewDesc: A group project in creating a platform that users can sign up and leave reviews for video games. We made both a web and native Android application. I contributed by designing and implementing REST APIs, and integrating external APIs to enhance the application's features.
projects.sobelDesc: I participated in a group research project on multithreading edge detection algorithms. I contributed by writing prototypes and researching methods to run the Sobel edge detection algorithm in parallel.
projects.backtesterDesc: An ongoing project on creating a GUI backtesting engine for trading and investing. The engine is written in Go and runs each portfolio concurrently across a worker pool, backed by a DuckDB database holding the asset data a user might want to backtest. I have since built a desktop interface on top of it with Wails, so runs, equity curves, SQL queries, and stock screening all live in one app, and strategies can be written in Lua without rebuilding the binary.
projects.httpServerDesc: A HTTP/1.0 server written in Go without net/http. I implemented the request line and header parsing, body handling, status codes, response writing, and a small router myself, with each connection served on its own goroutine. I am currently working a layer further down, writing my own TCP listener directly against Linux syscalls to sit underneath it. It is a project I took on to understand what the standard library is actually doing on my behalf.
